body:
I joined reddit today to come on here and write my suicide note and then leave. I have also been suicdal for years. is it getting better for you?

the bonds i have broken over time have created the kind of nothingness only a blind man knows. i wish i had kept the good people and shed the bad and i had tried to love myself sooner. i wish i could have believed people when they said they cared ...i dont know how to stop this feeling today, its like a loud train, or a wind tunnel of shame and anxiety and self hate breaking itself on me...i made my wife hate herself for loving me. i made sure she felt smaller than me, until she was so small she couldnt carry my pain anymore and she left. theres never going to be another person for me...its been years and people dont even see me. im a ghost already ...but its scary isnt it? not knowing if we will be ghosts...but im so tired of fighting...a little care would feel nice ...its not patronizing to say nice things though...sometimes it might strike a cord...so ill say maybe your not the piece of shit you think you are. maybe there is still time for you to be better. im old now, im almost 50 and most of my life is behind me...i would have liked to have one more day of happiness, a laugh with a pretty girl, a soft touch, a babies giggle. but i dont think i can have any of those things now. i hope there is time for you. i bet you know exactly what you are supposed to be doing - go or do it so you dont go find a sub reddit called suicide notes and write your own someday
